title: Goniometry Foundations — Axis, Arms, Scale and the Six Steps

hook.en: A goniometer is only as accurate as the person holding it. Learn the six steps, why the arms matter more than the axis and how to read a scale without fooling yourself.
hook.ur: Goniometer utna hi sahi hota hai jitna usay pakarne wala. Chhe steps, arms axis se zyada kyun ahem hain aur scale ko bina khud ko dhoka diye parhna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll set up any goniometric measurement in six steps, align the arms on bony landmarks, read the correct scale and record the result like a professional.
goal.ur: End tak aap kisi bhi goniometric measurement ko chhe steps mein setup karenge, arms ko bony landmarks par align karenge, sahi scale parhenge aur result professional tareeqay se likhenge.

text.en: A universal goniometer has a **body** (a protractor with a fulcrum or axis at its centre), a **stationary arm** fixed to the body and a **moving arm** that rotates and points to the scale. You place the axis over the joint's axis of movement, the stationary arm along the proximal segment and the moving arm along the distal segment. The reading is the angle the **distal segment has moved** from the start position.
text.ur: Universal goniometer ki **body** (protractor jis ke beech fulcrum ya axis), **stationary arm** (body se fixed) aur **moving arm** (jo ghoomti hai aur scale par point karti hai) hoti hain. Aap axis ko joint ke movement axis par, stationary arm ko proximal segment ke saath aur moving arm ko distal segment ke saath rakhte hain. Reading woh angle hai jo **distal segment ne** start position se **tay kiya**.

text.en: Think of measuring the opening of a door. The hinge is the axis, the door frame is the stationary arm and the door is the moving arm. If you measure from a frame that has itself moved (the trunk leaned), the reading is wrong even though the door moved correctly. So you hold the frame still: that is stabilisation.
text.ur: Darwaze ke khulne ko naapne ka tasawwur karein. Hinge axis hai, darwaze ka frame stationary arm aur darwaza moving arm. Agar aap aise frame se naapein jo khud hil gaya ho (trunk jhuk gaya), to darwaza sahi hilne ke bawajood reading ghalat hogi. Isliye frame ko saakin rakhte hain: yehi stabilisation hai.

beats.title: Elbow flexion — a classic first measurement

intro.en: Press play and watch the goniometer: the axis sits on the lateral epicondyle, the stationary arm points to the acromion and the moving arm follows the radius toward the radial styloid. Pause at the end of range and read the angle. Use the **slow-motion** button.
intro.ur: Play dabayein aur goniometer dekhein: axis lateral epicondyle par, stationary arm acromion ki taraf aur moving arm radius ke saath radial styloid ki taraf. Range ke end par pause karein aur angle parhein. **Slow-motion** button use karein.

text.en: **The six steps — P S L A M R.** **P**osition the patient, **S**tabilise the proximal segment, find the **L**andmarks by palpation, **A**lign axis and arms, **M**ove and measure at the end of range (re-align first), **R**ecord. Say it out loud before every measurement until it is automatic.
text.ur: **Chhe steps — P S L A M R.** **P**osition (patient ko position dein), **S**tabilise (proximal segment ko), **L**andmarks (palpate kar ke dhoondein), **A**lign (axis aur arms), **M**ove aur measure (range ke end par, pehle dobara align), **R**ecord. Har measurement se pehle zor se bolein jab tak khud-ba-khud na ho jaye.

question.en: Which part of the goniometer matters most for an accurate reading?
question.ur: Accurate reading ke liye goniometer ka kaun sa hissa sab se ahem hai?

text.en: Aligning the two arms along the bony landmarks
text.ur: Dono arms ko bony landmarks ke saath align karna

feedback.en: Yes — the axis is only an approximation of the moving axis; when the arms follow the bones, the axis falls where it should.
feedback.ur: Haan — axis moving axis ka sirf andaza hai; arms haddiyon ko follow karen to axis khud sahi jagah par aa jata hai.

text.en: Putting the axis exactly on the joint line
text.ur: Axis ko bilkul joint line par rakhna

feedback.en: Many joints do not have a fixed axis; arm alignment is more reliable.
feedback.ur: Bohat se joints ka axis fixed nahi hota; arms ki alignment zyada bharosay ki hai.

text.ur: Sab se bara goniometer use karna

feedback.en: Size should match the joint, but it is not the main source of error.
feedback.ur: Size joint ke mutabiq honi chahiye, lekin yeh error ka asal sabab nahi.

intro.en: Watch the pelvis. The examiner holds the pelvis steady so it cannot tilt backwards. In the real world, a posterior pelvic tilt (the lower back flattening) adds false degrees of hip flexion — the classic substitution.
intro.ur: Pelvis dekhein. Examiner pelvis ko saakin rakhta hai taake woh peechay tilt na ho. Asal mein posterior pelvic tilt (kamar ka chapta hona) hip flexion ke jhoote degrees add karta hai — classic substitution.

title.en: Reading the scale without fooling yourself
title.ur: Scale ko khud ko dhoka diye bagair parhna

steps.title: Pick the scale that started at 0
steps.detail: Goniometers have two scales running in opposite directions. Read the one that was at 0 in the start position. || Woh scale chunein jo start par 0 thi

steps.title: Look at the scale straight on
steps.detail: Reading from the side (parallax) can shift the number by several degrees. || Scale ko seedha samne se dekhein

steps.title: Know the joints that do not start at 0
steps.detail: Hip abduction and ankle dorsiflexion often start at 90° on the goniometer: record the change, not the dial number. || Un joints ko jaanein jo 0 se shuru nahi hote

steps.title: Re-align before reading
steps.detail: The arms drift as the limb moves. Re-check the landmarks at the end of range, then read. || Parhne se pehle dobara align karein

steps.title: Round to the nearest 1–5° and stay consistent
steps.detail: Measurement error of about 5° is normal; don't claim a 2° change is real. || Qareeb 1–5° tak round karein aur ek jaisa rahein

text.en: **Substitution and soft-tissue squeeze.** The back arches during shoulder flexion, the pelvis tilts during hip flexion, the foot rolls in during dorsiflexion: each adds degrees that do not belong to the joint. Pressing the goniometer into soft tissue shifts the arms. Stabilise, watch neighbouring joints and keep the goniometer flat against the limb. Never measure through pain without recording it.
text.ur: **Substitution aur soft-tissue dabao.** Shoulder flexion mein peeth arch hoti hai, hip flexion mein pelvis tilt hota hai, dorsiflexion mein foot andar ghoomta hai: har ek aise degrees add karta hai jo joint ke nahi. Goniometer ko soft tissue mein dabane se arms hil jati hain. Stabilise karein, qareeb ke joints dekhein aur goniometer ko limb par flat rakhein. Dard mein naapein to dard ko record kiye bagair kabhi nahi.

question.en: When recording hip flexion, the dial reads 130°, but the patient's pelvis tilted backwards during the movement. What should you do?
question.ur: Hip flexion likhte hue dial 130° dikhata hai, lekin movement ke dauran patient ka pelvis peechay tilt ho gaya. Kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Stabilise the pelvis and re-measure; the 130° includes false range
text.ur: Pelvis ko stabilise kar ke dobara naapein; 130° mein jhoota range shamil hai

feedback.en: Yes — substitution inflates the number. A true reading needs the pelvis held still.
feedback.ur: Haan — substitution number ko phula deta hai. Sahi reading ke liye pelvis saakin rakhna zaroori hai.

text.en: Record 130° because the dial says so
text.ur: 130° likh dein kyunke dial yahi dikhata hai

feedback.en: The dial shows the movement of the goniometer, not necessarily the joint.
feedback.ur: Dial goniometer ki movement dikhata hai, zaroori nahi ke joint ki.

text.en: Record the average of the two sides

feedback.en: Averaging two different joints hides a real asymmetry.
feedback.ur: Do mukhtalif joints ka average asal asymmetry ko chhupa deta hai.

text.en: **Record the full arc and the conditions.** "R elbow flexion 15–120° (PROM), pain at end range, supine" tells the next therapist that the elbow lacks 15° of extension and 30° of flexion. Write hyperextension as extra range beyond 0 ("0–10° hyperextension"). Use the same position, landmarks, device and (ideally) examiner at every visit, and link the numbers to function ("knee flexion 85° → 105°: now rises from a standard chair without hands").
text.ur: **Poora arc aur conditions likhein.** “R elbow flexion 15–120° (PROM), end range par dard, supine” agle therapist ko batata hai ke elbow mein 15° extension aur 30° flexion kam hai. Hyperextension ko 0 se aage extra range likhein (“0–10° hyperextension”). Har visit par wohi position, landmarks, device aur (behtar ho to) wohi examiner rakhein, aur numbers ko function se jorein (“knee flexion 85° → 105°: ab standard chair se bina haath ke uth jata hai”).

text.en: With the same examiner, positions and landmarks, goniometer reliability is **good** (intra-rater error is often within about 5° for most limb joints). Between different examiners it is lower, and spinal goniometry is the least reliable: inclinometers and tape methods are preferred. A change smaller than the measurement error (roughly 5° for most limb joints) may not be real.
text.ur: Same examiner, positions aur landmarks ke saath goniometer ki reliability **achi** hai (intra-rater error aksar zyada tar limb joints ke liye takriban 5° ke andar). Alag examiners ke beech kam hai, aur spinal goniometry sab se kam reliable hai: inclinometers aur tape methods behtar hain. Measurement error se chhoti tabdeeli (zyada tar limb joints mein takriban 5°) asli na ho.

question.en: Why do goniometers often read 90° at the start of hip abduction and ankle dorsiflexion?
question.ur: Hip abduction aur ankle dorsiflexion ke start par goniometer aksar 90° kyun parhta hai?

answer.en: Because the stationary and moving arms end up perpendicular to each other in the neutral position (the leg is at 90° to the pelvic line, the foot at 90° to the leg). The **movement** is the change from 90°, so you record the number of degrees travelled, not the dial reading.
answer.ur: Kyunke neutral position mein stationary aur moving arms ek doosray ke perpendicular hoti hain (taang pelvic line se 90° par, foot taang se 90° par). **Movement** 90° se tabdeeli hai, is liye dial ki reading nahi balkey tay kiye gaye degrees likhein.

question.en: Which statement about normal range of motion values is correct?
question.ur: Normal range of motion values ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?

text.en: They are guides that change with age, sex and the reference book; the other side is often the best "normal"
text.ur: Yeh rehnumai hain jo umar, gender aur reference book ke saath badalti hain; doosri side aksar behtareen “normal” hoti hai

feedback.en: Yes — compare with the patient's own other side and with function, not just with a table.
feedback.ur: Haan — patient ki apni doosri side aur function se compare karein, sirf table se nahi.

text.en: They are exact and the same for everyone
text.ur: Yeh bilkul durust aur sab ke liye ek jaisi hain

feedback.en: Reference values differ between sources and populations.
feedback.ur: Reference values sources aur populations mein mukhtalif hain.

text.en: A value below the table is always a disease
text.ur: Table se kam value hamesha bimari hai

feedback.en: Some healthy people are naturally stiff or hypermobile.
feedback.ur: Kuch healthy log fitri taur par sakht ya hypermobile hotay hain.

text.en: **Stop and refer** if movement is blocked with a hard, springy or empty end-feel, if there is sudden severe pain, a joint that looks hot, red and swollen with fever (septic arthritis) or suspected fracture. Do not force a joint beyond its end-feel to "get the measurement".
text.ur: **Ruk jayein aur refer karein** agar movement hard, springy ya empty end-feel ke saath band ho, achanak shadeed dard ho, joint garam, laal aur sooja hua ho aur bukhar ho (septic arthritis) ya fracture ka shak ho. “Measurement lene ke liye” joint ko end-feel se aage zabardasti na dhakelein.

summary.en: Six steps for every measurement: position, stabilise, landmarks, align, move and measure, record.
summary.ur: Har measurement ke chhe steps: position, stabilise, landmarks, align, move aur measure, record.

summary.en: Arms aligned on bony landmarks matter more than the axis; read the right scale straight on and record the change, not the dial number.
summary.ur: Bony landmarks par align arms axis se zyada ahem hain; sahi scale seedha samne se parhein aur dial number nahi, tabdeeli likhein.

summary.en: Stabilise to prevent substitution, accept about 5° error, and record the full arc, the position and any pain.
summary.ur: Substitution rokne ke liye stabilise karein, takriban 5° error maanein, aur poora arc, position aur dard likhein.

front.en: What are the six steps of goniometry?

back.en: Position, stabilise, find landmarks, align, move and measure (re-align), record.
back.ur: Position, stabilise, landmarks dhoondein, align, move aur measure (dobara align), record.

front.en: Where does the stationary arm point?
front.ur: Stationary arm kahan point karti hai?

back.en: Along the proximal segment, aligned on a bony landmark of the segment that does not move.
back.ur: Proximal segment ke saath, us segment ke bony landmark par jo hilta nahi.

front.en: How large is acceptable measurement error?

back.en: About 5° for most limb joints; a smaller change may not be real.
back.ur: Zyada tar limb joints ke liye takriban 5°; isse chhoti tabdeeli asli na ho.

front.en: How do you record hip abduction when the dial starts at 90°?
front.ur: Dial 90° se shuru ho to hip abduction kaise likhein?

back.en: Record the change from the start (0–45°), not the dial reading.
back.ur: Start se tabdeeli likhein (0–45°), dial ki reading nahi.
